verdict.rationale: A live probe found llms.txt returning HTTP 200 at developer.konghq.com, and it explicitly covers Kong AI Gateway documentation. The cited doc pages are themselves served as markdown (.md URLs such as ai-gateway.md and ai-gateway/mcp.md), giving agents clean, agent-readable docs. The 404 probe hit a malformed path (/ai-gateway/.md), not the real .md pages, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle.
